thread:
sara: Customer sent a failing tool-invoke for payment_gateway.process — customer sees 422 schema validation error 'additionalProperties' and also 500 in logs. Starts after SDK v1.3.2.
kevin: Can you drop the request payload + exact error text? Which model/tool/version?
sara: payload:
```json
{
  "customer_id": "C-12345",
  "items": [{ "sku": "foo", "amount": "1000" }],
  "billing_profile": "acct_900",
  "session": null
}
```
error from API: `ValidationError: instance.items[0].amount is not of type "number" — at /items/0/amount`.
infra-bot: alert: schema-validator (ajv) reject on /v1/tools/payment_gateway.invoke — 3 failures in last 10m
maria: probably the amount being a string. SDK 1.3.2 started sending form-encoded strings for amounts in certain legacy clients. Customer is on Dedicated + Private. They hit schema strictness in function-calling.
kevin: Repro steps: curl to host (customer env):
```bash
curl -X POST https://private.example.com/tool-invoke \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
 -d '{"tool":"payment_gateway.process","input": {"items":[{"sku":"foo","amount":"1000"}]}}'
```
response: 422 + JSON body `{"error":"schema validation failed","details":[{"instancePath":"/items/0/amount","schemaPath":"#/properties/items/items/amount","keyword":"type","message":"should be number"}]}`
sara: customer asks for workaround asap — their checkout is blocked, revenue impact. They want either a tolerant endpoint or a temp fix.
maria: Short-term: add middleware in private control plane to coerce numeric strings to numbers for fields defined as number (config flag). Long-term: update function-calling schema to accept string|number for legacy compatibility, but prefer migration docs and opt-in.
kevin: Assigning to @eng-infra to add coercion flag and to @eng-runtime to review schema change. I'll open CS ticket CS-4598 and set P1. Stacktrace from runtime:
```
Error: SchemaValidationError
    at validate (tooling/schema.js:142)
    at handleInvoke (runtime/invoke.js:87)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93)
```
sara: I'll repro on a local Dedicated clone and attach both request/response logs + customer SDK version info. Any preferences on telemetry/log redaction?
kevin: Keep request ids + tool name + truncated payload. Remove any PII. Add raw ajv error array to ticket.
maria: I'll draft a short KB article: 'Tool invoke: schema validation failures for numeric fields' with steps: upgrade SDK, enable coercion flag, patch middleware. Link to ticket when done. :writing_hand:
sara: Thanks — I'll post updates here. Escalating to oncall if no patch within 24h. :rotating_light:
